summary: Fresh non-author source-attribution review of CANDIDATE-PART.json v2 (Part 1, 18 claims: G01, P01-P10, T01-T07) conducted as Gemini 4 Argon (High) through Antigravity (requested gemini-4-argon-high HIGH; runtime model identity self-report is stated honestly and is not an independent provider cryptographic attestation). This is a fresh one-attempt audit of the v2 Sol-corrected candidate artifact after the earlier full 61-claim job ended without a completed object; no prior job was retried or resumed, and the prior Part 1 review embedded in FINDING-DISPOSITIONS.json was treated strictly as historical context rather than approval for changed bytes. Using read-only view tools only, all 11 files listed in MANIFEST.json (plus MANIFEST.json itself) were inspected with zero unread truncation on full reads: MANIFEST.json (lines 1-74), CANDIDATE-PART.json (lines 1-823, read in two bounded ranges 1-365 and 350-823), CORE-ir.rs (lines 1-484), CORE-lib.rs (lines 1-42), CORE-parser.rs (lines 1-378), CORE-stage-mod.rs (lines 1-188), CORE-stage-profile.rs (lines 1-32), S06-frontend.rs (lines 1-69), INPUT-MANIFEST.json (lines 1-244), PATTERN-INVENTORY.json (lines 1-123), FINDING-DISPOSITIONS.json (lines 1-350, read in two ranges 1-260 and 261-350), and a bounded partial read of graph.json (lines 1-40 of 1646) covering G01 and its enclosing metadata block. Every literal excerpt, SHA-256 digest, line span, classification (SOURCE_DECLARATION, CALL_EDGE, INFERENCE), and bounded statement across all 18 claims (G01, P01-P10, T01-T07) was independently verified against the supplied source files. In particular, all three prior precision findings are confirmed resolved in v2 across the 7 changed claims (P02, P04, P09, P10, T03, T06, T07): (1) F01 is resolved in P02, which now states the full format string literals moriarty-stage-plan/1, moriarty-continuation/1, and moriarty-stage-event/1 and restricts its citation span to CORE-stage-mod.rs lines 23-32 (excluding STAGE_LABELS on lines 33-38); (2) F02 is resolved in P09 and reviewScope/reviewPart metadata, which explicitly distinguish the 33-file parent source packet (core-frontend-source-input/MANIFEST.json, supplied here as INPUT-MANIFEST.json with sha256 bdebc38482bcedc067aebe7cc2bc80d5cacc46b516ec3195f24dcf512d11596e, cited in P09 citation 2 at lines 1-243 under its parent filename MANIFEST.json), the historical 9-file Part 1 v1 review workspace, and the current 11-file Part 1 v2 review workspace; and (3) F03 is resolved in P04, P10, T03, T06, and T07, where T03 (CORE-ir.rs lines 91-117), T06 (CORE-ir.rs lines 188-211), and T07 (CORE-ir.rs lines 212-270) now start on their leading derive attribute lines, P04 and P10 (S06-frontend.rs lines 34-50) include the closing brace of admit_source on line 50, and T07 explicitly states that Step.effects and Execution.effects are Vec<Effect> sequences without implying PartialOrd or Ord for Effect. With PATTERN-INVENTORY.json (sha256 8fde592bfc941b1743da9427a88223a1689df2fa3bb33772adfddfbbfcd23997) now directly supplied in the 11-file packet, all 20 familyInventory entries (S01-S04, escrow-time, interval-boundary, joint-role, oracle-observation, the four swap/batch entries, F01-origination through F04-fee-gross-net-policy, and AP01-AP04) were directly checked against PATTERN-INVENTORY.json lines 4-119 and verified to preserve exact IDs, names, line spans, literals, and UNINSPECTED_BOUNDARY / UNLOCATED_IN_THIS_PACKET status without following any case_file paths. Snapshot provenance separation is strictly maintained between the 5 supplied CORE-*.rs files pinned to mainCommit 8174e52975d8db9bf59636fea0fa338c0f47c855 and S06-frontend.rs / graph.json from backend source_head 54fc7a1a54106245abb1a5ef6e16407464e1b654, with no semantic or runtime equivalence inferred. Core1, Staged2, and Sherlock/draft profiles are kept distinct; language() is solely a profile routing check; stage::load call ordering (separated by U+2192 rightwards arrows in P08) constructs stage plan/cost metadata rather than compiled circuit lowering; Core IR and v1 serde wire declarations do not prove dependency or runtime behavior; and laterSourceNotes referencing LEXER-HELPER-SOURCE-TABLE.json remain explicitly unreviewed source-only observations outside this packet. Source attribution is ready for Part 1's 18 claims only (not the other 43 claims of the 61-claim table), with operatorReady, securityReady, runtimeReady, and ledgerReady all false and nativeAuthority 0.
